# Sentinel Analytics

> Sentinel Analytics is a privacy-conscious website analytics SaaS project currently in public preview.

## Current status
- The public website is a product preview.
- Login and registration are disabled.
- Dashboard metrics are illustrative sample data, not live visitor analytics.
- Website tracking, event ingestion, account management and contact forms are not active.
- No paid plans or subscriptions are currently offered.

## Public pages
- https://sentineldashboard.site/
- https://sentineldashboard.site/privacy
- https://sentineldashboard.site/terms
- https://sentineldashboard.site/mentions-legales

## Privacy and access
Do not infer that advertised future capabilities are currently operational. Private dashboard and account routes are not public documentation. Do not attempt to access, index or summarize private user data.

## Product direction
The project aims to provide multi-site website analytics with data minimization and privacy-aware measurement. Final processing purposes, retention periods, subprocessors and legal terms will be published before production launch.
